# pyvswitch

> A Python version manager for Windows. It lists every installed Python, switches which one
> `python` runs, downloads and installs any python.org release, and manages packages separately
> for each interpreter. It ships a desktop and tray app, a native CLI with `--json` output, and an
> MCP server, so it can be driven by people, scripts and AI assistants.

When pyvswitch is installed, the `pyvswitch` command is on PATH. Run `pyvswitch ai guide` for a
complete, self-contained reference written for assistants.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, screenshots, install instructions
- [CLI reference](docs/CLI.md): every command, selector syntax, JSON output, exit codes
- [AI and MCP guide](docs/AI.md): `pyvswitch ai setup`, supported tools, MCP tool list
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): quick command table, plus conventions for working on the repository
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Most-used commands

- `pyvswitch list --json`: installed interpreters and the active one
- `pyvswitch use 3.12`: make a version the default `python` (new shells only)
- `pyvswitch install 3.13 --use`: download, install and activate a version
- `pyvswitch add <package>... -p 3.12`: install packages into one interpreter
- `pyvswitch run -p 3.11 -- script.py`: run a version without switching
- `pyvswitch doctor --json`: diagnose PATH problems
- `pyvswitch mcp`: start the MCP server on stdio
